scope: Line-indexed inventory of previous NFL sites, generators, datasets, research references and shared navigation/CI context; this is not a claim that every legacy historical statistic was re-fetched.

critical_findings.finding: Existing 2026 games file carried mixed NFL/PFR verification provenance; this session revalidated 136 completed Week 1-9 games against official NFL schedule/game pages and reconciled W-L-T/PF/PA 32/32. The new canonical snapshot drops PFR references.
Legacy ESPN market/futures values and older Spreadspoke/nflverse-derived backtests are not official NFL/bookmaker evidence; not reused and explicitly flagged.
Multiple older standings, injury and odds files are frozen at 2026-11-02. They are not presented as a live Week 10 state; current official values are separate.
Some official club depth charts are marked unofficial and do not establish active status, snap share or actual replacement; Houston's fetched chart is image-only and string assignments remain blank.

All earlier source and analysis claims not individually re-fetched are marked as legacy-scope/review-needed in this line register. The current site only reuses facts with a current official source row or reproducible official-result derivation.
